eventDetail.scope: IEEE-LANANO fosters global collaboration and knowledge exchange in nanoscience and nanotechnology throughout Latin America. IEEE-LANANO 2026 will spotlight several emerging areas, including (1) advanced nanomaterials, (2) new trends in nanoelectronics, (3) nanotechnology in life sciences, (4) machine learning in nanotechnology, and (5) quantum technology, alongside other nanotechnology-related fields.
